SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.target_type='ALERT' THEN CASE WHEN a.status='REVOKED' THEN 'REVOKED' WHEN a.status IN ('OPEN','CONFIRMED') THEN 'EFFECTIVE' END ELSE END AS effective_status FROM alert_appeal p LEFT JOIN alert_record a ON p.target_type='ALERT' AND a.id=p.target_id LEFT JOIN recognition_record r ON p.target_type='RECOGNITION' AND r.id=p.target_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.driver_id=#{owner}

SELECT * FROM alert_appeal WHERE target_type=#{type} AND target_id=#{targetId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE alert_appeal SET status=#{status},decision_reason=#{decisionReason},reviewer_id=#{reviewerId},reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt},update_time=#{updateTime} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
